settings.heading: Just Mushrooms
settings.text: A small tincture maker in Plettenberg Bay, Western Cape.

settings.heading: Honest is the premium position
settings.text:
Functional mushrooms attract big claims. We think a brand that grades its own claims, cites its sources and says plainly what a bottle cannot do earns more trust than one that promises everything.

NEEDS CLIENT INPUT: founder story, when the business started, who makes the tinctures, and any facts about the workshop we may publish.
